definition: [ שָׁגֵל ] verb violate, ravish (Masoretes think verb obscene, and substitute שָׁכַב ); — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular suffix יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה Deut 28:30 Kt ( Qr יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה ). Niph`al Imperfect 3 feminine plural תִּשָּׁגַלְנָה Isa 13:16 ; Zech 14:2 women shall be ravished (both Kt ; Qr תִּשְּׁכַבְנָה ). Punic < Qal passive ( Ges «GKC:52e»§ 52e ) Perfect 2 feminine singular אֵיפֹה לֹא שֻׁגַּלְתְּ Jer 3:2 where hast thou not been ravished ? ( Qr שֻׁכַּבְתְּ ).
